subject.description: Literature in English syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.2.2 WRITTEN LITERATURE
topics.description: Written literature encompasses various artistic works in the form of prose, drama, and poetry. By studying these forms, learners gain a deeper understanding of how writers use language to communicate, inspire, and challenge their audiences.

sub_topics.name: SUBTOPIC: 1.2.2.1. FORMS OF WRITTEN LITERATURE
sub_topics.description: Learners discuss written literature and its various forms, including prose, drama, and poetry, while distinguishing written literature from oral literature.

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC: 1.2.2.2. PROSE
sub_topics.description: Covers continuous writing in fiction and non-fiction, structural elements such as plot, character, setting, theme, conflict, and point of view, as well as composing short stories on cross-cutting themes.

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC: 1.2.2.4 Poetry
sub_topics.description: Appears within the Sample Lesson Plan section, focusing on understanding poetry and its structural elements including form, line, and stanza.
